generatedUsernameNotice: You will be given a random nickname when you join.

autoAdvance.hint: Move on by itself after the reveal and the leaderboard.
autoAdvance.label: Auto-advance

generatedUsernames.label: Generate nicknames
generatedUsernames.hint: Players pick from generated names instead of typing their own.

answersOnly.label: Answers only
answersOnly.hint: Players only see the answer buttons, with a button to read the question again.

antiCheat.label: Anti-Cheat Protection
antiCheat.hint: Automatically expels participants who split their screen or switch windows during the quiz.

hidePlayerResults.label: Host-only results & ranking
hidePlayerResults.hint: Only the host sees answer correctness and rankings. Participants see a clean waiting screen.

pauseOnDisconnect.label: Pause timer on disconnect
pauseOnDisconnect.hint: Automatically freeze the round countdown if any participant goes offline so they do not lose time.

ultimateTimer.label: Ultimate Quiz Timer
ultimateTimer.hint: Sets an overall countdown time limit for the entire quiz to end. Participants must answer all questions before time runs out.

selfPaced.label: Self-Paced Exam Mode
selfPaced.hint: Participants answer at their own speed, skip questions, and revisit them anytime

maxParticipants.label: Participant Limit
maxParticipants.hint: Limit how many participants can join this quiz (0 for unlimited)

antiCheat.banner: Anti-cheat active: Screen splitting or window switching will result in expulsion.
